Tours begin in the Crystal River National Wildlife refuge, and the points of interest are adjusted seasonally to ensure the best chance at a glimpse of the wildlife and fauna the Nature Coast is famous for. blurb: Gulf Coast Expeditions offers guided snorkeling tours to swim with manatees in Florida's fresh water springs. Tours are conducted in small groups with experienced guides who also take photos and videos. The company emphasizes safety, conservation, and education in partnership with US Fish and Wildlife.
